messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.44-9
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.44-9) has been released at its website (http://rqtl.org) and will be on CRAN in the next day or two.

This is mostly a set of small bug fixes, though we did add the ability to control the colors used in geno.image().
For a list of the changes, see https://github.com/kbroman/qtl/blob/master/NEWS.md

Karl Broman
